# Wave Motion Cannon

> > An anime criticism site specializing in sakuga analysis, translated director/animator interviews, and episodic coverage of Japanese animation.

Wave Motion Cannon features in-depth articles on animation production, translated interviews with legendary directors like Mamoru Oshii, Hayao Miyazaki, and Akiyuki Shinbo, alongside weekly episode reviews and sakuga breakdowns. The site focuses on technical animation analysis, industry insights, and critical discussion of anime series and films.

## Key Topics

- Sakuga analysis
- Director interviews
- Animator interviews
- Animage translations
- Episode reviews
- Animation production
- Yutaka Nakamura
- Mamoru Oshii
- Mob Psycho 100
- Gundam Thunderbolt
- Weekly anime coverage
- Japanese animation industry
- Ghost in the Shell
- Podcast episodes

## Director & Animator Interviews

- [Interview: Akiyuki Shinbo (Animage February 2005/Vol 320)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/11/15/interview-akiyuki-shinbo-animage-february-2005vol-320): Translated Akiyuki Shinbo director interview from Animage 2005
- [ON YOUR MARK – An Interview with Hayao Miyazaki (Animage, 09/1995)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/01/17/on-your-mark-an-interview-with-hayao-miyazaki-animage-091995): Hayao Miyazaki discusses On Your Mark music video from Animage 1995
- [Interview: Yutaka Nakamura (WEB Anime Style, 7/19/2003) Part 1](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/10/05/interview-yutaka-nakamura-web-anime-style-7192003-part-1): Translated Yutaka Nakamura animator interview from WEB Anime Style 2003
- [Mamoru Oshii & Masaki Yamada: Discussing Innocence (Animage, October 2003)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/04/04/mamoru-oshii-masaki-yamada-discussing-innocence-animage-october-2003): Oshii and Yamada discuss Ghost in the Shell: Innocence from Animage 2003
- [Mamoru Hosoda Digimon Interview (Part 2)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/11/05/mamoru-hosoda-digimon-interview-part-2): Translated Mamoru Hosoda interview from Digimon Movie Book (2001)
- [Lupin the Third: The Blood Spray of Ishikawa Goemon – An Interview with Director Takeshi Koike (Animage, March 2017)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/08/22/lupin-the-third-the-blood-spray-of-ishikawa-goemon-an-interview-with-director-takeshi-koike-animage-march-2017): Takeshi Koike discusses Lupin IIIrd Goemon film from Animage 2017
- [Interview with 'To Be Hero's lan](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/11/11/interview-with-to-be-heros-lan): Animator lan discusses Chinese animation production on To Be Hero

## Sakuga & Animation Analysis

- [Weekly Motion Cannon: Mob Psycho Episode 3](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/07/27/weekly-motion-cannon-mob-psycho-episode-3): Sakuga analysis of Mob Psycho episode 3 featuring animator Gosei Oda
- [Weekly Motion Cannon: Mob Psycho Episode 9](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/09/06/weekly-motion-cannon-mob-psycho-episode-9): Episode 9 review of Mob Psycho 100 analyzing character development
- [Gundam Thunderbolt: Hope, Despair, Sakuga](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/09/02/gundam-thunderbolt-hope-despair-sakuga): Audio essay critiquing Gundam Thunderbolt's sakuga and narrative choices
- [Thunderbolt](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/06/04/thunderbolt): Review of Gundam Thunderbolt exploring jazz soundtrack and war themes

## Weekly Episode Reviews

- [Weekly Motion Cannon: Miss Kobayashi's Maid Dragon Episode 13](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/04/07/weekly-motion-cannon-miss-kobayashis-maid-dragon-episode-13): Final episode review of Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid by Kyoto Animation
- [Weekly Motion Cannon: Scum's Wish Episode 6](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/02/20/weekly-motion-cannon-scums-wish-episode-6): Episode 6 analysis of Scum's Wish psychological drama
- [Weekly Motion Cannon: March comes in like a lion Episode 9](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2016/12/19/weekly-motion-cannon-march-comes-in-like-a-lion-episode-9): Episode 9 review of March comes in like a lion shogi drama

## Podcast Episodes & Audio Content

- [Weekly Motion Cannon Podcast Episode 06 – The Sound of Silence](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/06/12/weekly-motion-cannon-podcast-episode-06-the-sound-of-silence): Podcast discussion of A Silent Voice film with CJ, Jimmy, and Josh Dunham
- [Blade Licking Thieves – Ghost in the Shell (2017)](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/04/15/blade-licking-thieves-ghost-in-the-shell-2017): Podcast review of 2017 Hollywood Ghost in the Shell live-action film

## Anime Criticism & Essays

- [Hokuto No Competition](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/01/19/hokuto-no-competition): Analysis of Fist of the North Star's narrative structure and power creep
- [Anime of the Year: Grant's Top 5 Anime of 2016](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/01/13/anime-of-the-year-grants-top-5-anime-of-2016): Grant's personal top 5 anime list for 2016 including Yuri on Ice
- [Ask Tomino: I can't wake up by myself](https://wavemotioncannon.com/2017/06/24/ask-tomino-i-cant-wake-up-by-myself): Translated Tomino advice column from Animage August 2011
